summary: All eight round-1 issues are fixed: the founders_seal lesson tag is gone and the 'lock' line is blurred, both partner casts now require tagged(partner, student) (Ilse is role outsider and Bram role prefect, so neither can be cast), the courtyard seasons cover all four, beast_complaints makes the owls' draught the standing grievance, and both zh fixes landed. Every opening ladder is now a bare sequence, and no stock 'X again' rungs remain in the English. The re-review found no new canon, safety or class-rule problems. One zh polish point remains.

rulings.progression_rungs: Keep 'More bread', 'More original work' and 'Another courtyard hour' (and 'Another hour on the bucket'). Each is the middle rung of a sticky sequence, so it shows exactly once, and each adds new information in the same sentence (smell is where liars are caught; the porters step round you now; your answers get longer). They mark progress through the course, which a stock 'X again' rung doesn't.
rulings.sticky_last_rung: With repeat: 4, showings 3 and 4 share the last opening rung. That's fine: the ~ lines, season and gpa conditionals, and final_year branches vary the rest, and the last rungs are written as settled routine ('Some mornings you could do it asleep').

issues.problem: zh polish: the middle rung is translated '又是面包', which turns the English progression rung back into the stock 'X again' opening. The same happens in illu_courtyard_hour ('又是庭院的一小时'), illu_original_work ('又是原创作业') and beast_complaints ('又在桶上…').
issues.fix: Translate the sense of progression, not repetition, e.g. '面包课还没完。', '庭院一小时，照旧。', '原创作业继续。', '还是那只桶。'.
